metadata.label: Valais / Wallis — initial regional study
metadata.model: Scheduled interpolation along reviewed federal infrastructure and OSM-inferred bus roads; not observed vehicles.
metadata.scope: At least one original GTFS call coordinate in the unsimplified 2026 Valais canton polygon. Full journey retained, including every call outside Valais. No operator whitelist.
metadata.admission: Whole journeys only: every original call and permission retained. Any missing segment or prior-arrangement call excludes the entire journey.
exclusions: Initial Friday/Sunday September study; no year-round geometry claim.
All modes and annual routes remain in the census. Cableways, funiculars, water, tram, DFB and VerticAlp tourist rail require separate reviewed geometry.
Infrastructure shortest paths and OSM road inference are not observed vehicles, running-track selection, operator direction certification or temporary diversion confirmation.
Full cross-border calls retained; no clipping to canton or geometry extent.
Fixed-stop GTFS census does not establish completeness of services absent from the archive or GTFS-Flex areas.

geometry.model: Infrastructure and road inference; full journeys only

frequency.model: Only exact scheduled instances admitted in this initial scope; headway candidates remain in coverage audit.
